title: Post-falsification full 3x3 real-SWAP predictor envelope diagnostic
method: Call Fgc44RealSwap.try_initialize_configured for every unchanged Cartesian-product point.
Immediately query predictor_run_diagnostics after every call.
For status 0, additionally query e1_diagnostics and verify production q_u, HCOF/RHS and physical mass identities.
For nonzero status, record the configured stage and predictor diagnostics without retry/tolerance/physics changes.
hard_controls: The original first matrix point duration=5e-5, qbot=5e-7 remains nonzero status; do not erase the DSW22 falsification.
The admitted F-GC44 default point duration=1e-4, qbot=1e-6 returns status 0.
All status-0 cases satisfy q_u reconstruction, HCOF/RHS algebra and SWAP mass closure.
All nine points are attempted exactly once in the declared matrix.
characterization: status topology over duration and qbot
accepted substeps, attempts, retries and solver/temporal/mass rejection counters
u and q_u only at successful points
forbidden: do not relabel the original DSW22 all-nine gate as passed
